// diagnostic

E0112

This value has a type that does not fit the argument, print, or interpolation site

What

This value has a type that does not fit the argument, print, or interpolation site

Why

Jet checks each use so a call cannot receive or render the wrong type

Fix

Use a value of the expected type, or convert it before passing or interpolating it

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0112: tests/ui/E0112_int_from_float_brace.stderr.

Error [jet.ValueTypeMismatch]: A `Float` can't be used where a `Int` is expected
  --> tests/ui/E0112_int_from_float_brace.jet:3:14
    |
  3 |     n :: Int{x}
    |              ^
 Why: A typed literal accepts its body like a parameter; converting a decimal value to a whole number must be explicit
 Fix: Use `Int.from_float(value)` and handle its failure, or `math.round(value)` to round to the nearest Int
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112
